verdict.rationale: mise can be extended through several backends: asdf plugins remain usable, vfox plugins can be wired in (e.g. `vfox:mise-plugins/vfox-php`), and any tool's backend can be overridden with `MISE_BACKENDS_<TOOL>`. Third-party sources such as npm, pipx, github, aqua and arbitrary http URLs also work as backends, and community users confirm it supports many more package sources than asdf. Missing for 10: first-party docs on authoring your own plugin or backend, and evidence of adding custom third-party registries (taps/overlays).
